messages:
maya: quick heads-up — p99 host ingress CPU up ~10% after the kernel-selector change on canary. traces attached but tl;dr lots of tiny allocs in request parse + tokenization.
daniel: which canary id? did kv cache miss rate move too?
maya: runtime-canary-3. p99 bumped 86ms -> 95ms on 1k qps soak. kv miss +4% on the sample window. saw grpc writev spikes and more small writes.
li: grabbing flamegraphs now. early look shows parse_line() and Tokenizer::emit_chunk dominating the delta. also small heap allocs from HeaderParser are popping up (mallocs per request).
sanjeev: curious if batching heuristic change caused smaller batches and more overhead?
maya: median batch size same, but tail shows more micro-bursts => more frequent small writes. probably chunking threshold got lowered by the proto-slicer tweak.
perf-bot: profile summary: Top symbols: HeaderParser::parse_line (15%), Tokenizer::emit_chunk (12%), grpc::Writev (9%), kv_cache::lookup_miss (7%), memcpy (5%). full profile uploaded to S3.
daniel: easy first step: revert chunk_coalesce_threshold to previous value and repro. also check iovec path for grpc writes.
li: confirmed an extra memcpy in streaming framer that forces fallback off iovec path for responses < 512B. moving to iovec avoids copy and reduces syscall count.
maya: proposed plan: 1) eliminate short-lived heap alloc in HeaderParser by using a stack buffer reuse; 2) raise chunk_coalesce_threshold + revert proto-slicer tweak; 3) force iovec write path for streaming small responses.
sanjeev: I'll run a matrix: canary with patch, canary w/o kernel-selector change, and baseline. 10k qps daytime run + 1k steady soak.
maya: created branch host-ingress-heaplet-fix, PR #4237. added perf test plan and flame graphs in the PR comment.
daniel: thanks. if tail improves we'll roll the changes to dedicated canary and then staged rollout.
li: ping me when runs complete, I can re-check kv hit patterns and flamegraphs.
maya: will do. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: run command used for repro: `bench/run_ingress_canary.sh --canary runtime-canary-3 --qps 1000 --dur 600 --collect-profile s3://redwood/perf/9145003210`
maya: also leaving note: keep an eye on p50/p90 for client-visible regressions, not just p99.
daniel: agreed. thanks all.
